info.description: One sellable SKU — attach Options values (Size, Color, Storage, Pack…) instead of hard-coded fields

item_code.description: Your own short code to recognise this SKU, e.g. Grey-Hoodie-M

size.description: Legacy — prefer Options values. Kept for old rows and CSV import (auto-synced)

color.description: Legacy — prefer Options values. Kept for old rows and CSV import (auto-synced)

color_photos.description: More photos for this look — detail shots and alternate angles

price_for_bulk.description: How much per unit when buying many (leave empty if no bulk price)

how_many_left.description: How many of this SKU you currently have

option_values.description: Options values for this SKU — e.g. Size=M + Color=Black, or Storage=256GB

product.description: Which product this variant belongs to
